findings.passage: “This is common-sense election reform legislation would support our poll workers as they work to keep polling sites secure from election fraud,” said Rep. Byrd.
findings.note: Statement in her name in a House press release about HB 228, which would bar certain identification from use for in-person voting.

findings.motion: HB 228, certain identification not valid for in-person voting
findings.note: Press release says she introduced HB 228 to prohibit certain types of identification for in-person voting. A news report (thestarnewsnetwork.com, 2021-02-06) says it would require licenses of non-citizens to read “BEARER NOT A U.S. CITIZEN — NOT VOTER ID”. Date is the release date.

findings.passage: I will fight for hand-marked paper ballots, strong chain-of-custody safeguards, and a process the public can trust. That also means ending reliance on electronic voting systems and withdrawing from voter data-sharing organizations such as ERIC.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, election-integrity section. Page is undated. Related topics: paper ballots, voter-roll data sharing, not ID rules directly.

findings.motion: HB 1109, certain driver's licenses and ID cards not proper identification for a poll worker
findings.note: Aggregator page lists her among four sponsors of HB 1109 (2025-2026 session) and shows its status as failed. Official legislature page was not read.
